apps.localizedDescription:
🚧 New project, still in beta:

Airclone is young software, and we are working through making every feature stable on every platform it ships to.

Issues are welcome, and encouraged — [open one.

(Settings → Diagnostics → Problem report → Copy report): it names your version, platform and package, and secrets are stripped as it is recorded. For a security problem, please use Report a vulnerability under the Security tab instead of a public issue.

Questions, ideas and how-tos go in Discussions — ask how to set up a remote, suggest a feature, or show what you built with it. Issues stay for things that are broken.

versions.localizedDescription:
The rclone engine moves to 1.76.0:

Airclone now ships rclone 1.76.0, which is mostly a security and data-safety update. Nothing changes in how you use the app, and your remotes keep working as they are.

• Security: rclone is built with Go 1.27.3 and updated network and compression libraries, which fix several published vulnerabilities. A redirect from HTTPS to plain HTTP is now refused, and sign-in details no longer follow a redirect to another host on the storage types that leaked them. Local file operations can no longer be tricked by a planted symlink into deleting or changing files outside the folder you chose.
• Don't lose files on rename: renaming a file so that only its letter case or Unicode form changes, or moving a file onto its own name, could delete it. Both are fixed.

• New storage types: Dosya and Infomaniak kDrive appear in the Add remote list.

Notes:

• In filters, now negates a character set and [^.] no longer matches /. If you wrote a filter that relied on the old meaning, check it.
• A server that redirects from HTTPS down to plain HTTP now fails instead of being followed. Moving that server to HTTPS is the fix.
• The new rclone index command is blocked in the in-app console for now, because it writes listing files into a remote.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Airclone uses the camera only to scan a configuration QR code you generate yourself. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
